Synthetic Spectral Bounds on Weighted Lattices

Abstract

We prove exponential mixing in Theorem 2.2 using synthetic energy bounds.

1 Setup & Notation

Let G=(V,E)G=(V,E) be a finite graph with weights & capacities ≤ 1.
